name: Dark Life [Beta]
desc:
The game is like DarkRP, Da hood, build a boat
You have to build bases and protect your money printers and bitcoin 
Take your earnings in your wallet to the deposit button on the map to pay money into your bank. 
If your killed the money in your wallet drops 
Money in the bank is Safe

Use the money to get big weapons and upgrade your base and weapons
